scenes.location: Hamack bar and post-Joe party interactions.
scenes.storyState: After Joe joins, the party gathers the bar lead and heads toward the spaceport before Mars.
scenes.purpose: Translate all remaining R02 required interaction headers and the connected post-Joe party TALK alternatives.
previousContext: Joe has joined the party after Sion explained Lucia’s disappearance. The bar informant reported that Lucia may have left for Mars.
followingContext: The party plans to check the spaceport and investigate the report.
branchAlternatives: 082000:011–013 are randomized Sion lines; 017/019 are job branch variants; 018/020 are party character remarks; 021–023 are selected after the Mars lead.
evidence: Fresh source replay and RE-confirmed post-Joe flag and party branch closure.
uncertainty: The informant’s sighting and Mars ship destination remain hearsay.
A phrase spoken while Joe sleeps is unclear.
notes: Speaker labels and runtime name tokens are preserved separately.
scenes.reviewNote: Reviewed the complete token order, character assignments, and source-proven flag branches. Keep rumor uncertainty and avoid treating randomized lines as a sequence.
